issues.description: The solution implementation declares some attribute getter methods with private visibility (getLectureName and getNumberOfInscribedStudents), while the exercise instructions and test names expect public getters for each attribute. This visibility mismatch will prevent students/tests from accessing those getters and causes failures when following the specified API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public (e.g., public String getLectureName(), public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()) so they match the exercise description and expected tests. Ensure the template's method signatures (when added) and the solution use public visibility for these getters.
